title: Close garden cricket
description: Clear close cricket pulses from a garden at night, with quiet spaces between calls.
author: Vrymaa
sourceDescriptionSummary: The creator describes close, clean crickets in a garden at night, without added reverb or echo. The original is mono.
access: Public HQ MP3 preview, without login, account, or paid service; original WAV download requires Freesound login.
processing: Select source seconds 22–58; 1800 Hz two-pole high-pass to remove low background wash; fixed 17.917094 dB gain throughout, 5 ms click guards at both boundaries, 1-channel 44.1 kHz 192 kbps MP3. No added compression, AGC, limiting, noise gate, dynamic denoise, envelope riding, time/pitch change, artificial pulse, or added layer. Runtime circular overlap handles the loop seam. The downloaded public preview is retained byte-for-byte; original uncompressed source was not downloaded.

validation.scope: Signal measurements only; not a perceptual certification of source, dryness, or absence of musical content.

envelope.scope: Signal amplitude evidence only. Natural rainfall intensity and insect pulse gaps may vary; these measurements do not identify sources or certify perceptual absence of pumping.

listeningReview: Source-page descriptions, waveform and spectrogram inspection, and signal/envelope measurements; no human listening certification.
